caveats: This is a byte-based planning estimate calibrated from one successful Codex CLI invocation; actual per-request token usage varies and must be read from JSONL.
The 75000-token threshold is the current single-call pilot gate, not a formal experiment budget or account limit.
The profile uses complete induced legal turns; it does not prove route-generation success or dynamic SUMO behavior.
